violations.rule: Pin the exact version of every library and tool the spec names
violations.why: The architecture names Postgres 16, but the render.yaml databases block declares no Postgres version (e.g. postgresMajorVersion), so Render's current default major would silently diverge from the Postgres 16 pinned by local compose and the CI service container.

notes: Staging DB network access posture unstated: design requires external connections (laptop worker, seed, psql) but the runbook never sets Render's DB IP allow-list or records acceptance of allow-any-IP-with-credentials; credential-gated + sslmode=require, so not cited as a default-deny violation.
Start-time migration failure handling is only implicit (&& short-circuit + failed health check); one runbook troubleshooting line would make the boundary explicit.
Spec location docs/specs/ is compliant: project-standards §4 overrides the global docs/superpowers/specs/ convention.
Cosmetic: one scenario uses Given→Then→When ordering.

staging-rebuild recipe guards SEED_ALLOW_REMOTE presence only, not exact-host match, before alembic — mistyped remote DATABASE_URL could receive migrations the seed step then refuses; low stakes, exact match still protects data writes
